description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Group of Employees Inclusive of Mr. J. T. Danawala Vs. Tea Shakthi Fund (S & E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the revocation and issuance of orders under the Industrial Disputes Act, which is a piece of legislation.
